blurb: The Atlanta Ice House is a 130,000 square-foot ice rink sports complex in Marietta, GA, featuring an NHL regulation ice rink, training rink, Olympic sized pool, workout centers, and private online schooling. It offers programs including the USPHL Atlanta Madhatters junior hockey teams, Learn to Skate USA, and youth hockey clubs. The facility hosts public skating sessions and various events throughout the year.
